Showing a BAND is industry standard (5 of 6); Cut Protocol grading a band while DISPLAYING A POINT is the worst configuration -- the user cannot tell whether they passed. Red-on-over is the category default => amber is marketable divergence, and calm-amber-plus-explanation is a position NOBODY occupies. Delivered 3 constitution-compliant infeasibility copy blocks.
